changelog: - **A meeting can finally be moved, called off or deleted** (#1980). `/api/meetings/[id]` had no `PATCH` and no `DELETE`, so the only way to fix a wrong time was to schedule a second meeting and abandon the first — which stayed on the dashboard banner, in the reminder queue, in the calendar, in the `.ics` feed and on the participant's real Google Calendar forever. `Meeting` gains `status` (`MeetingStatus { SCHEDULED | CANCELLED }`), `cancelledAt` / `cancelledById` / `cancelReason`, `rescheduledAt` / `previousScheduledAt` so "this moved" is answerable without an audit join, and `batchKey` (indexed) — the shared identity of one bulk schedule, written by `POST /api/meetings`, so a cancel can mean this invitee (`scope: 'one'`, the default) or the whole session (`scope: 'batch'`); a null key means just this row, never "all the nulls". `PATCH` moves the time (re-parsed through `parseUserDateTime` against the actor's zone, never a bare `new Date()`, #1061), the clock, the title and the room link, clears `reminderSentAt` so the new time gets its own reminder, stamps the old time, and resets an RSVP that was given to the time nobody is meeting at any more; `status: 'CANCELLED'` records who called it off, when and why. `DELETE` removes the row — and what was *written* in the meeting survives, because `PersonalNote.meetingId` and `InteractionLog.meetingId` are `onDelete: SetNull` on purpose. Both refuse a meeting whose `endedAt` is set (410) and `PATCH` refuses one already cancelled (409); a cancelled row stays deletable, which is the only way a mistake ever leaves the list. Authorization is server-side and fail-closed in one place — the new `canManageMeeting()` in `src/lib/meetingAccess.ts`: organiser, the relation's mentor, admin. A MENTEE is a participant, not the owner (they decline; counter-proposals are #1982), and a COMPANY or SOURCE session never reaches the rule at all — every refusal answers exactly like an unknown id, so the id space stays opaque. Cancelling and deleting call `removeMeeting()` (its first real call site; #1986 owns the rest) before the rows go, since `GoogleCalendarEventLink` cascades away with the meeting; a move re-pushes, which PATCHes the event already on the invitee's calendar instead of leaving a second one next to the stale first. Both verbs are rate-limited (`meeting-mutate`, 20/min), audited (`meeting.cancel` / `meeting.delete`), and `meeting.rescheduled` + `meeting.cancelled` join `WEBHOOK_EVENTS`. Every reader that answers "is there a meeting?" now filters CANCELLED out: the dashboard banner, the reminder cron, `/api/calendar-events`, the ICS subscription feed, the public per-meeting `.ics` (410) and the auto-log sweep — a meeting that was called off did not take place, and writing "the scheduled meeting took place" into a mentee's history would be a false record. `e2e/meeting-reschedule.spec.ts` covers schedule → move → cancel, the mentee's and an unrelated mentor's 404, batch vs single scope, and a delete that keeps the note and the log.

en: A meeting can now be rescheduled, cancelled or deleted instead of being abandoned at the wrong time — a cancelled meeting disappears from the dashboard, the calendar, the subscription feed and the reminder e-mails, and is withdrawn from the calendars it was mirrored to.
Moving a meeting sends the reminder again for the new time, remembers the time it moved from, and asks the invitee to answer again — an acceptance of the old time does not count for the new one.
Deleting a meeting keeps what was written in it: the notes taken and the interaction log entry stay.
Only the person who called the meeting, the mentee's mentor or an administrator may change it; a mentee replies to an invitation rather than moving it.
tr: Bir toplantı artık yanlış saatte bırakılmak yerine ertelenebiliyor, iptal edilebiliyor ya da silinebiliyor — iptal edilen toplantı panodan, takvimden, abonelik akışından ve hatırlatma e-postalarından düşer ve yansıtıldığı takvimlerden geri çekilir.
Toplantı taşındığında hatırlatma yeni saat için yeniden gönderilir, eski saat kayda geçer ve davetliden yeniden yanıt istenir — eski saate verilen 'katılıyorum' yenisi için sayılmaz.
Toplantıyı silmek, içinde yazılanları silmez: alınan notlar ve etkileşim kaydı yerinde kalır.
Toplantıyı yalnızca onu planlayan kişi, mentee'nin mentoru veya bir yönetici değiştirebilir; mentee toplantıyı taşımaz, davete yanıt verir.
de: Ein Meeting lässt sich jetzt verschieben, absagen oder löschen, statt zur falschen Zeit stehen zu bleiben — ein abgesagtes Meeting verschwindet aus dem Dashboard, dem Kalender, dem Abonnement-Feed und den Erinnerungs-E-Mails und wird aus den Kalendern zurückgezogen, in die es gespiegelt wurde.
Beim Verschieben wird die Erinnerung für die neue Zeit erneut verschickt, die alte Zeit bleibt festgehalten, und die Zusage wird neu erfragt — eine Zusage zur alten Zeit gilt nicht für die neue.
Das Löschen eines Meetings löscht nicht, was darin geschrieben wurde: Notizen und der Eintrag im Interaktionsprotokoll bleiben erhalten.
Ändern darf ein Meeting nur, wer es angesetzt hat, die Mentorin oder der Mentor des Mentees oder eine Administratorin; ein Mentee antwortet auf die Einladung, statt sie zu verschieben.
